statement: A lapse in federal appropriations begins 2026-10-01 because no measure funding agencies past 2026-09-30 is enacted.
resolution: Congress.gov shows no continuing resolution or appropriations act funding federal agencies past 2026-09-30 signed into law on or before 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: A continuing resolution or appropriations act covering federal agencies past 2026-09-30 becomes public law on or before that date.

statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range at its scheduled 2026-09-16 decision, above the current 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
resolution: The FOMC statement released 2026-09-16 sets a target range whose upper bound exceeds 3.75 percent.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 statement holds the range at 3.50 to 3.75 percent or cuts it.
